title: Arazzo 1.1.0 Released!
relevance: P1-6 payload XPath / P0-5 XPath criteria

raw.title: Arazzo 1.1.0 Released!
raw.body:
## What's Changed

* feat(spec): added support for AsyncAPI v3 by @nashjain in https://github.com/OAI/Arazzo-Specification/pull/367
* Clarify origin or runtime expressions ABNF non-terminals by @char0n in https://github.com/OAI/Arazzo-Specification/pull/325
* fix: fix referenced stepId in examples by @char0n in https://github.com/OAI/Arazzo-Specification/pull/358
* fix(schema): remove conditional statement for type: retry in failure action object by @jeremyfiel in https://github.com/OAI/Arazzo-Specification/pull/343
* fix(schema): remove enumeration in failure action object by @jeremyfiel in https://github.com/OAI/Arazzo-Specification/pull/348
* refactor(arazzo): remove brackets around condition by @char0n in https://github.com/OAI/Arazzo-Specification/pull/362
* feat(spec): Add support for JSONPath and XPath where JSONPointer is supported by @frankkilcommins in https://github.com/OAI/Arazzo-Specification/pull/409
* feat(spec): Allow workflow inputs to be passed in success and failure actions by @frankkilcommins in https://github.com/OAI/Arazzo-Specification/pull/416
* feat(spec): Add `querystring` support compatible with OAS 3.2 by @frankkilcommins in https://github.com/OAI/Arazzo-Specification/pull/443
* feat(runtime-expressions): improve ABNF grammar clarity by @frankkilcommins in https://github.com/OAI/Arazzo-Specification/pull/454
* feat(spec): Add $self for identity-based referencing by @frankkilcommins in https://github.com/OAI/Arazzo-Specification/pull/451
* Clarify Criterion Object condition evaluation semantics by @frankkilcommins in https://github.com/OAI/Arazzo-Specification/pull/475
* Add missing schema validation fixtures for async, OpenAPI, and workflow steps by @nashjain in https://github.com/OAI/Arazzo-Specification/pull/476

## House Keeping
* example: match ABNF for runtime expressions by @markus-96 in https://github.com/OAI/Arazzo-Specification/pull/339
* fix(examples): Update JSON Path condition to conform to RFC 9535, and show two valid condition flavours by @frankkilcommins in https://github.com/OAI/Arazzo-Specification/pull/478
* chore(repo): Update README for 1.1 release prep by @frankkilcommins in https://github.com/OAI/Arazzo-Specification/pull/477

## Infrastructure Items
* main: Create publishing PRs in new site repo by @ralfhandl in https://github.com/OAI/Arazzo-Specification/pull/376
* chore: fixes dark theme rendering by @baywet in https://github.com/OAI/Arazzo-Specification/pull/381
* ci: adds a dependabot configuration to maintain workflow and test projects up to date by @baywet in https://github.com/OAI/Arazzo-Specification/pull/382
* ci: adds a code owners configuration so reviewers get automatically notified by @baywet in https://github.com/OAI/Arazzo-Specification/pull/383
* Fix md2html yargs initialization by @frankkilcommins in https://github.com/OAI/Arazzo-Specification/pull/483
* spec publishing script: create/update minor-version softlink for all versions by @ralfhandl in https://github.com/OAI/Arazzo-Specification/pull/484
* schema-publish.sh: sync with OAS sibling by @ralfhandl in https://github.com/OAI/Arazzo-Specification/pull/486
* V1.1 release prep by @frankkilcommins in https://github.com/OAI/Arazzo-Specification/pull/481
* 1.1.0 minor version by @frankkilcommins in https://github.com/OAI/Arazzo-Specification/pull/482

## New Contributors
* @markus-96 made their first contribution in https://github.com/OAI/Arazzo-Specification/pull/339
* @baywet made their first contribution in https://github.com/OAI/Arazzo-Specification/pull/381
* @nashjain made their first contribution in https://github.com/OAI/Arazzo-Specification/pull/367

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/OAI/Arazzo-Specification/compare/1.0.1...1.1.0
